page.overview:
What is Vaults of Zin?

The Vaults of Zin is a fictional location created by the late American author H. P. Lovecraft for his fantasy novella The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath.

An enormous cavern complex located in the underworld, the Vaults of Zin lie near the cemetery of the Gugs, which opens onto a large cave which, in the words of its origin story, "is the mouth of the vaults of Zin, and the vindictive Ghasts are always on watch there murderously for those denizens of the upper abyss who hunt and prey on them." (: The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath)
